metric: RESULT settle_saves_* and receipt_frozen_at_last_save: ledger saves per _accumulate_energy settlement crossing into February (the only caller of _roll_month, coordinator.py:10306), and whether the frozen receipt precedes the last save
base: direct _roll_month: saves_close=1; settlement: 2 saves, receipt frozen at last save 1
mut: direct: saves_close=0; settlement: 1 save, receipt frozen at last save 1 (same stored state)
inputs: settlement with an injected fault after the roll
should: none on a reachable path: the settlement saves the ledger unconditionally after the roll (coordinator.py:10332 for energy <= 0, 10401 otherwise), so the receipt is persisted by the same settlement; only a settlement that raises after the roll separates the arms (fault arm: 1 save vs 0)
